findings.title: Israeli court extends detention of Gaza hospital director for 6 months
findings.location: Israeli court in Beersheba, Israel; detainee is director of Kamal Adwan Hospital, northern Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_system: Dr. Hussam Abu Safiya; detained Gaza physician and hospital leadership/medical workforce
findings.affected_population: Dr. Hussam Abu Safiya; detention of other physicians mentioned as background only
findings.affected_system: Detention and due-process status of Gaza medical personnel; no independently verified present-day change to Kamal Adwan Hospital service capacity
findings.exact_supporting_passage: An Israeli occupation court extended the detention of the director of a Gaza hospital for another six months without filing charges against him
findings.source_type: Established Palestinian news agency reporting named human-rights organization Physicians for Human Rights–Israel (PHR); underlying court order not directly reviewed
findings.summary: WAFA reported, citing Physicians for Human Rights–Israel, that a Beersheba court rejected attorney Nasser Odeh's release request and extended without charges by six months the detention of Kamal Adwan Hospital director Dr. Hussam Abu Safiya, held since December 27, 2024. Report also cited concerns regarding his health and detention conditions. This is a change in an ongoing detention, not a new arrest.
